summary: A real <table> with fixed lanes and one flexing column, three densities (row 36/44/56, inline 12/16/24, body 13/14/16), sortable headers that report rather than sort, row selection whose labels the type requires, and loading and empty bodies that keep the header and the lane widths. The frame carries three corner values, all as drawn: radius-lg outside, the concentric calc(radius-lg - space-xs) on the body's clip — the sheet's 12px, which is not a step on the radius scale — and radius-md on the body's top edge. The row fill, the dividers and the first row's corners all sit on the CELLS — border-radius does not apply in the collapsing border model and a <tr> renders none in either, so the sheet's rounded first row forces the separate model. The dividers are border-b-elevated — the mat itself showing between rows that float on it, rather than a border role free to drift from the surface it imitates. Rows are not tab stops: everything a row does is reachable from the checkbox inside it, and the sheet's focus row is drawn with has-[:focus-visible] on the row. The design corrections are recorded in the doc's needsDesign, the two largest being hover and press painted the same value (shipped per the sheet's own annotation as bg-hover and bg-active, so a press has feedback at all) and the disabled row's text-disabled ink, which measures 2.09:1 in light — a row's data is content, not an inactive control's label, so it ships at text-muted. The gutter's annotated 3px selection edge is NOT shipped: selection is only reachable through the select lane, so a selected row always carries a checked box.

migration.manual: New item — nothing to migrate. `npx shadcn add @bydiorama/table`; it pulls in `cn`, `checkbox` and `use-controllable-state`, and expects react and griddy-icons as peers. Table sorts nothing: hold the sort state and order the rows yourself, and give getRowId a stable id rather than an index or selection follows the wrong rows the first time a column is sorted.
